svg.text: class Judiciary Information System — implementation model
Extends Django AbstractUser; selected inherited fields.
User links are typed association properties below; each reverse multiplicity is 0..*.
[1] = required reference; [0..1] = nullable. Role restrictions are enforced by services.
DateTime = timezone-aware (UTC storage; Asia/Kolkata display). PK/FK = database keys.
Case is null for account-management events.
Register/reassign: at least one active Lawyer
and one active Judge are required.
Removed links are deleted; assignment changes
Later deactivation does not erase attribution.
Case has one Registrar and one current Judge.
User roles are values, not subclasses/tables.
judge_id is a User FK, not a professional ID.
No employeeId or barCouncilId is modeled.
{one Judgment per Case; immutable after saving}
Booked = SCHEDULED or RESCHEDULED. Unique (judge, starts_at) while booked;
at most one booked Hearing per Case. Historical hearings have no fixed upper limit.
ADJOURNED ⇒ starts_at is null; otherwise a timestamp is required.
COMPLETED ⇔ nonempty summary, summary_by and completed_at are present.
Other states have blank summary and null summary_by / completed_at.
HearingChange preserves old/new status and time, reason, actor and timestamp.
+ update_assignments(actor, pk, version, judge, lawyers, reason)
+ change_hearing(actor, pk, hearing_id, version, action, reason, starts_at=None)
record_judgment stores judgment + closes Case + writes audit in one transaction.
No separate closeCase(), reopen(), general updateCase() or updateProfile().
change_hearing handles rescheduling and adjournment; views pass the action.
Login / logout through core.views and Django auth
Retention: every domain FK shown uses PROTECT; no normal hard-delete workflow. Account removal means deactivation, preserving records.
Closure: CLOSED ⇔ one Judgment and closed_at present. Judgment insertion triggers closure; service transaction includes audit and rollback.
Closed cases cannot be reopened or changed through normal workflows; completed summaries and judgments remain immutable.
Reassignment moves booked hearings only if conflict-free; completed hearing / judgment authorship stays unchanged. version rejects stale updates.
Layering: views/forms → business services → repository/ORM → PostgreSQL. Django handles authentication/password flows separately.
Fields use actual model names; references are model properties (physical FK columns end in _id). String/Text lengths are declared limits.
No composition diamonds: ownership does not imply cascading deletion. Framework session internals and routine ORM methods are omitted.
